content: This is the Màs Monumental Stadium 🏟️ located in Buenos Aires Argentina. Home of the River Plate Football Club ⚽️❤️🤍. Club Atlético River Plate (CARP) is one of Argentina’s biggest football clubs. It has a capacity of 84,567. It is the largest stadium in South America. It’s named River Plate after an English modification of the estuary it’s by: Rio de la Plata. 🏟️ The Rosebowl Stadium in Los Angeles has a capacity of 89,702. 🏟️ The University of Michigan Stadium has a capacity of 107,601 (third largest in world). the energy of the fans in Argentina’ Estadio Màs Monumental is unparalleled to the culture in sporting events in America. To address the numbers: While the capacity of the largest stadium in South America is smaller than American stadiums, Argentinian stadium’s can only be filled by the home team’s fan base. Buenos Aires has one of the highest concentration’s of football clubs per city. The biggest rivalry in the city is between River Plate and Boca Juniors.
